verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs that third-party clients can be pointed at manually, and it ships its own `local-ai chat` shell agent. Neither is a single-command launcher that starts popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured for local models. API compatibility is only a building block that requires user-side configuration, and the first-party agent is a different feature, so no credit applies.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
